The most efficient strategy is to repeatedly pair up identical boxes of size $s$. If we have $2M$ boxes of size $s$, performing $M$ moves with $k=s$ results in $M$ new boxes of size $2s$, and all $2M$ original boxes become empty (assuming they are consumed). This reduces the box count by $M$.
